page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-055 is kept in a storage container in a low-security wing. The container is labelled. Staff who read the label are asked not to report what it says, as they will not be able to.
SCP-055 is not to be opened. **Staff are reminded that SCP-055 has never been opened.** Records of the occasions on which it was opened are kept with this file.
The container is audited once a week. The audit has always found SCP-055 present, and has never been able to say what was present.

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-055 is a briefcase. This is the only statement about it that staff have been able to keep in mind for longer than a few seconds.
The following is also known. SCP-055 is not round. It is not warm to the touch. It is not made of glass, it does not hum, and it is not red. It is not, as far as anyone can tell, alive.
Staff who open SCP-055 are later found standing a short distance away, unharmed, facing in no particular direction. Each of them has said the same thing: they have no idea what they just saw.
This file has been rewritten %releven%r times. Every version described SCP-055 in full. No reader has been able to say what any of them said.

page.title: Addendum 055-1: Test Log
text: Test 055-01: a researcher opened SCP-055. %rResult not retained.%r
Test 055-02: a researcher opened SCP-055 on camera. The footage shows the researcher. It does not show the case.
Test 055-03: a researcher was asked to describe SCP-055 without opening it. She described a briefcase, then asked what we wanted her to describe.

page.title: Addendum 055-2: Provenance
page.text: SCP-055 has no recovery record. It was handed to a reader of this file by the individual in Foundation dress described in the files of other objects. The reader confirms this. The reader does not recall what was handed over. See field notes.

jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp055_case.1: SCP-055 is a briefcase. It is black, or possibly dark grey.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp055_case.2: It is not round. It is not warm. Nobody has ever described it as heavy, or as light, or as anything else.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp055_case.3: Sneak and use it on a block to set it down. Sneak and use the case with an empty hand to pick it back up. It fits in a storage container, where it does nothing. You remember that much.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp055_case.4: It cannot be crafted. According to its dossier, a stranger in Foundation dress hands it to whoever reads that dossier. You are sure there is more to say about this.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp055.0: The courier hands something over. Nobody wrote down what.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp055.1: Whatever it is, it is not round.
